steps.path: The version chip at the bottom of the window, once an update has downloaded
steps.headline: The chip now reads "Ready - restart needed", with the same yellow pulse.
steps.changed: "v1.4.0 ready — restart to update" becomes "Ready - restart needed", your words in sentence case (only the first word capitalised, like every label in the app).
steps.notice: The chip is shorter. The version number is still on the chip's hover hint and on the popup's Restart to update button.
steps.risk: The chip no longer says which version is waiting until you hover it or open the popup.

steps.path: Settings → Help & feedback, scrolled to the bottom
steps.headline: Get beta builds and Install updates automatically now sit under their own heading, Updates.
steps.changed: Contribute to YouCoded stays alone under Help build YouCoded; a new last group, Updates, holds the two switches, the same name the update popup uses for them.
steps.notice: The switches are under a heading that says what they are.
steps.risk: Get beta builds moved down one group from where it was before today.
